extraction_policy: Generalize proven patterns, not imagined reuse.

typography.principle: data typography is distinct from narrative/product typography

layout: compact identity/broadcast layer above the working field
thin rules and deliberate spacing before nested cards
motion: horizontal broadcast ticker for circulating network facts
live-state activity rail for ongoing computation
all continuous motion removed or converted to static/scrollable state under prefers-reduced-motion
accessibility: mobile security and authority-boundary language must stay readable
qa_method: explicit uncertainty ledger when browser observations conflict with deterministic source evidence

fae_specific_do_not_extract: orange topper as FAE identity signature
blue circulation as FAE live-state metaphor
FAE product narrative and sovereign/fair-launch visual voice
future_trigger: Extract a Waterfound Visual System only after another real product proves reuse of these primitives without carrying FAE-specific identity.
